about.description: An embeddable, portable, branchable virtual machine to safely run Agents locally.
about.head: a28b33c

name: smolvm v1.37.5
body:
## What's Changed
* Keep a pack's layers directory reachable by the VM when the pack was built under a strict umask by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2433
* Fix three macOS test flakes: open-file exhaustion, a missed socketpair wakeup, and a cargo-only env var by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2429
* Let a non-root workload own a folder mounted into a running machine from another filesystem by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2435
* Refresh the guest firmware to renew overdue CPU quotas by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2436
* Check every path a machine's dropped uid needs before boot, and fix three pre-existing permission bugs it exposed by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2438
* Allow live CPU grow and shrink on Linux arm64 by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2437
* Fix guest Vulkan on Intel GPUs that do not share the CPU cache by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2426
* Prepare SmolVM v1.37.2 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2439
* Refresh forwarded ports on Docker container events by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2444
* Pin libkrun to 36b08461 for live vCPU resize on Linux arm64 by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2440
* Stop a guest thread that outlives its Vulkan instance from crashing on exit by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2443
* Keep seed eviction's backing scan from blocking machine creates by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2445
* Forward only list and sign to the host SSH agent so a machine cannot add, remove, or lock its keys by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2441
* Guard forced machine stops with a host PID by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2447
* Keep older-layout pack layers readable under the per-VM uid drop, and repair existing caches by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2448
* Report a machine whose image workload failed to launch instead of a plain running start by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2449
* chore(nix): bump flake to 1.37.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/2450


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/compare/v1.37.1...v1.37.5
